title: ID0419172-DC/Si-D/DK[Xdc81P] - DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101
description:
Charger shows error on DC2, there is a know issue with 375A Phoenix cables. We have replaced 6 cables already in Denmark.
Please check that the PT1000 temperature sensors shows invalid values.

Problem Description
: DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 error
Troubleshooting

I checked the WebUI remotely and seems like one sensor is good and the other isn't. We need to go on site and test the resistance from the cable and see if it's a cable problem or not. Please measure the CP to ground to understand if there might've been water ingress.
I recommend taking a spare cable and StateMonitor in case we need to replace any of them.
